text:
maria: Seeing a weird p99 jump on Console for /v1/generate in eu after we flipped a routing fallback. Legend shows sample origin as 'client' but our raw query shows gateway-origin values. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/abc
anish: can you paste the query you ran?
maria: ran this quick query in telemetry:
```
SELECT tdigest_percentile(latency_ms, 0.99) as p99
FROM service.latency
WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND region='eu' AND time > now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY minute
```
It returns ~220ms but console is showing ~1.2s for p99.
elaine: did we change sample-source tags on the fallback policy? I vaguely recall adding a `fallback_weight` label last week.
maria: not on the policy I toggled. rollout r-2026-11, just flipped fallback_weight=0.2 earlier.
infra-bot: Deploy r-2026-11 completed to eu-prod at 1798804305 :rocket:
sam: possible aggregation mismatch — console uses a decaying window rollup with tdigest, while your raw query is reading pre-rollup raw points. different algorithms + windowing can cause big diffs.
maria: dashboard shows "sampled rollup" and the legend bubble reads 'client' which is misleading because merged-rollup rows should show origin=gateway_primary.
devex: we introduced a legend simplification that maps merged-rollup -> client to reduce noise in small charts. that was deliberate but might be incorrect here. i flagged a convo in #eng-runtime about it.
olivia: if legend is wrong folks will misattribute latency to client SDKs. we should either revert mapping or make tooltip show raw origin. propose: tooltip shows 'origin: merged-rollup (gateway primary)'.
elaine: agree. also we need to ensure console p99 uses the same percentile algorithm as raw telemetry (tdigest vs naive). mismatch can blow up when sample counts are low.
maria: sample count here is ~120 over 15m. still shouldn't be 1.2s vs 220ms.
sre-oncall: tagging this as incident-ish. @maria can you add a couple trace IDs for the slow outliers so i can pull logs?
maria: added traces: https://traces.redwood/abc123 and https://traces.redwood/abc124
sam: quick mitigation: add a small tooltip footnote "Console p99 uses rollup-tdigest with decaying window; compare with raw-query for absolute values." That should reduce misattribution.
devex: i'll open a tiny PR to change the legend mapping back to showing merged-rollup as 'merged-rollup (gateway)' and add the tooltip. also adding a short rollout-ux blurb about what origin labels mean.
maria: thanks. follow-up: can we add an option in the latency pane to surface the percentile algorithm and sample-count? users ask this a lot.
olivia: +1. filing a product ticket.
maria: will re-run a re-aggregation job now and post results.
infra-bot: Re-agg job started (job id reagg-1798804333). ETA ~8m.
maria: re-agg finished, console p99 now shows ~240ms and legend shows 'merged-rollup (gateway)'. looks aligned. closing for now :white_check_mark:
